description: Fetch a public https CSV URL and parse it into headers + rows ($0.005 USDC via x402). https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs are rejected. Caps: 1 MB body, ~10s timeout, max 5 redirects, max 5000 data rows (truncated with warning). Optional has_header (default true). Returns JSON { url, final_url, content_type, headers, rows, row_count, warnings }. As is, no warranty. Nothing stored.

has_header.description: If true (default), treat the first row as column headers. If false, synthesize col_0..col_N.

url.description: https URL that returns CSV to parse into a table. http/file/data/localhost/private IPs rejected.

name: csv-to-table
